en: Real photo postcard: a black‑and‑white studio portrait of a WWII-era German/Austrian soldier in uniform, standing full-length against a painted backdrop. The reverse has a divided back with German handwriting in pencil and blue ink, dated 20.11.43, names Lederer Elisabeth and Lederer Andreas, and an address on Königsgasse. A faint purple photographer's stamp runs vertically along the left edge.
